_comment: Maps current PHMSA operator key (OPERATOR_ID_STOP) to predecessor keys that covered the same territory in earlier years. The build script backfills missing years from predecessor data. Edit this file to add/remove mappings, then re-run s07_build_phmsa_timeseries_json.py.

40196_MA.note: Eversource Gas of Massachusetts (2020+). Formerly Columbia Gas of Massachusetts; NiSource sold the MA distribution business to Eversource in 2020 following the 2018 Merrimack Valley gas explosions.

16667_NH.note: Energy North Natural Gas NH (2003+), filed as KeySpan Energy Delivery - Energy North until 2007. One predecessor only: KeySpan Energy Delivery 31459_NH (2000-2002), a clean operator-id change — 1,181 mi and 57,573 services in 2002 against 1,239 and 59,273 in 2003, and 63 vs 62 customers per mile. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES 4485_NH, EnergyNorth Natural Gas 1997-1999, which looks like the earlier link but reports only about 40% of the system: 484 mi in 1999 against 1,147 in 2000 while EIA customers stayed flat (72,618 to 72,580), giving an implausible 150 customers per mile where this utility has run at 62-63 ever since. All of New Hampshire reported 936 mi in 1999, so the 1,147 cannot be a real gain. Adding 4485 would invent a doubling in 2000; the backfill's own median guard would drop those years anyway.

32513_IL.note: Ameren Illinois (2010+). Three predecessors, matching the EIA side: Illinois Power (8,051 mi), AmerenCIPS (5,071) and Central Illinois Light/CILCO (3,718). They sum to 16,840 against the 16,874 filed in 2010, a ratio of 0.998. Only Illinois Power had been mapped, leaving the series to double at the handover.

15359_WY.note: Black Hills Energy WY (2016+). Three predecessors, not one: Black Hills NW Wyoming (419 mi), SourceGas LLC (2,009 - Black Hills acquired SourceGas in 2016) and Cheyenne Light Fuel & Power (947, a Black Hills subsidiary folded in). They sum to 3,375 against the 3,396 filed in 2016, a ratio of 0.994. Mapping only the first left an 8x discontinuity.

31636_ND.note: NORTHERN STATES POWER CO OF MINNESOTA (ND, filings from 2002). Renamed/reorganized from NORTHERN STATES POWER CO (1998-2001); name match score 100 with nesting place tokens.

31770_MA.note: LIBERTY UTILITIES (NEW ENGLAND NATURAL GAS COMPANY) CORP (MA, filings from 2004). Renamed/reorganized from NEW ENGLAND GAS COMPANY (1997-2003); name match score 65 with nesting place tokens.

31859_IL.note: VILLAGE OF MORTON (IL, filings from 2006). Renamed/reorganized from VILLAGE OF MORTON (1997-2005); name match score 100 with nesting place tokens.

40804_TX.note: STERLING CITY GAS DEPT (TX, filings from 2023). Renamed/reorganized from STERLING NATURAL GAS INC (1997-2022); name match score 71 with nesting place tokens.

Renamed/reorganized from NORTHWEST NATURAL GAS CO (1997-2003); name match score 94 with nesting place tokens. allow_level_change because the predecessor really does drop from 145 to 78 miles in 2002 and the successor's own 2004 reads 79.6 — the collapse guard read that genuine step as a partial sum and discarded 2002 and 2003.

31860_LA.note: TOWN OF FRANKLINTON (LA, filings from 2003). Renamed/reorganized from FRANKLINTON, TOWN OF (1997-2002); name match score 97 with nesting place tokens.

31357_MS.note: GEO PETROLEUM ENERGY TRANSMISSION LTD (MS, filings from 1999). Renamed/reorganized from GEO PETROLEUM ENERGY TRANSMISSION, LTD (1998-1998); name match score 99 with nesting place tokens.

31636_SD.note: NORTHERN STATES POWER COMPANY OF MINNESOTA (SD, filings from 2002). Renamed/reorganized from NORTHERN STATES POWER CO (1998-2001); name match score 93 with nesting place tokens.

31945_OH.note: ENERGY MGT SYSTEMS, INC LAKESIDE DIVISION (OH, filings from 2002). Renamed/reorganized from LAKESIDE GAS CO (1997-2001); name match score 70 with nesting place tokens.

30879_OH.note: GASCO DISTRIBUTION SYSTEMS, INC. (OH, filings from 1999). Renamed/reorganized from GASCO DISTRIBUTION SYSTEMS OF KY, INC. (1997-1997); name match score 89 with nesting place tokens.

31840_AZ.note: UniSource Energy Services AZ (2003+). Same operator renamed under a new PHMSA id; UniSource acquired Citizens Utilities Arizona gas assets in 2003.

15359_KS.note: Black Hills Energy KS (2007+). Fills the 1998-2006 gap from Aquila Networks (Kansas); Black Hills acquired Aquila Kansas gas distribution in 2008.

15518_TN.note: Piedmont Natural Gas TN (2007+). Nashville Gas Company is Piedmont Tennessee division under its former PHMSA id.

40400_RI.note: Rhode Island Energy (2022+). Four-stage lineage: Bristol & Warren Gas + Valley Gas + New England Gas consolidated into New England Gas in 2003 (mileage 2,380+593+85=3,058 matches the 3,056 filed that year, so 1997-2002 is correctly summed); National Grid then filed RI gas under the Niagara Mohawk operator id 2006-2021; PPL acquired it as Rhode Island Energy in 2022. Southern Union Gas 18532_RI is deliberately excluded as a duplicate of the New England Gas division.

39102_MD.note: Sandpiper Energy MD (2013+). Acquired the Eastern Shore Gas Company distribution systems in 2013 and converted them from propane to natural gas.

15359_AR.note: Black Hills Energy AR (2016+). Black Hills acquired SourceGas in 2016; continuity 0.98.

32198_MN.note: Minnesota Energy Resources (2006+). Aquila sold its Minnesota gas utility in 2006; continuity 0.99.

31470_OH.note: Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio (2000+). Vectren acquired Dayton Power & Light natural gas business in 2000; continuity 0.99.

31349_MN.note: Fairfax, City of MN (1999+). Same town, formerly Fairfax Gas & Water System; continuity 1.00.

31808_WV.note: Canaan Valley Gas Co WV (2002+). Three-way merger of Town Gas, GASCO Distribution Systems and Ashford/Kenna Gas; their 1997-2001 shares (0.50+0.33+0.17) sum to exactly 1.00, so those years are summed.

38906_MO.note: Liberty Utilities (Midstates Natural Gas) MO (2012+). Liberty acquired the Atmos Missouri/Iowa/Illinois systems in 2012; continuity 1.00.

38906_IA.note: Liberty Utilities (Midstates Natural Gas) IA (2012+). Iowa side of the same 2012 Liberty/Atmos transaction; continuity 1.01.

38967_GA.note: Liberty Energy (Georgia) (2013+). Liberty acquired the Atmos Georgia system in 2013; continuity 1.06.

32647_OK.note: Navitas Utility Corporation OK (2012+). Formerly Fort Cobb Fuel Irrigation Authority, matching the existing manual EIA match; continuity 0.98.

31348_TX.note: Atmos Energy Mid-Tex (1999+). Lone Star Gas distribution division became TXU Gas and then Atmos Mid-Tex; continuity 0.99. The same system filed 2003 alone under operator 31978 'TXU GAS COMPANY' — 26,435 miles and 1,384,291 services, between 26,135/1,380,712 in 2002 and 27,038/1,420,543 in 2004 — so that year is windowed in from 31978_TX, which files no other year and has no territory of its own.

32397_OH.note: Glenwood Energy of Oxford OH (2007+). Formerly Oxford Natural Gas, same town; continuity 1.00.

31473_MS.note: Northeast Mississippi Natural Gas District (2000+). Verified: the district was created by the state legislature in 1961 as MANTACHIE Natural Gas District and later renamed Northeast Mississippi; source nemsnaturalgas.com history. Continuity 1.04. Williamsville Water Co was NOT included - no evidence it was part of this district.

6243_HI.note: Hawaii Gas. The same system filed 1999 as operator 30569 'GAS COMPANY, THE' at 598 miles and 2002 as operator 31273 'THE GAS CO' at 603 miles; each ID files that one year only. Matched on size, not name — 598 and 603 sit between the years either side.

18496_CT.note: Southern Connecticut Gas. 2002 filed under operator 18490 'SOUTHERN LNG, INC' at 2,202 miles, matching the 2,202 wanted between 2001 and 2003. That ID files no other year.

31632_MT.note: NorthWestern Corporation bought Montana Power's utility business in 2002. Montana Power (12690) kept filing through 2003, and NorthWestern's own 2003 is missing, so only 2003 is windowed in — 3,992 miles against 4,009 wanted. Its 1997-2001 years are NOT taken: NorthWestern's series starts at 2002 and a wider window would extend the utility back before it held the system.

39257_AK.note: INTERIOR GAS UTILITY (own filings from 2020). Acquired Fairbanks Natural Gas, whose PHMSA series ends 2019. Continuity is clean: Fairbanks reports 136.01 miles and 1,206 services for 2019, Interior 142.408 and 1,391 for 2020 — ratios of 1.05 and 1.15, consistent with a handover plus a year's growth. Interior then builds out fast, reaching 248.64 miles by 2025.

6720_KS.note: ATMOS ENERGY - COLORADO/KANSAS. Atmos acquired United Cities Gas in 1997; United Cities' Kansas series ends 1998 at 1,877 miles and Atmos Kansas steps 1,084 to 3,414 the next year. On the EIA side Atmos Kansas gains 76,595 residential customers exactly at the handover against United Cities' 74,207, within 3%.

13635_OH.note: NORTHEAST OHIO NATURAL GAS. Absorbed Orwell Natural Gas, whose series ends 2018 at 431.71 miles; NEO steps 866.26 to 1,582.25 for 2019. EIA agrees: NEO gains 11,989 residential customers against Orwell's 11,073. NEO's gain exceeds Orwell alone, so at least one further Gas Natural Inc. subsidiary was folded in at the same time and is not yet mapped.
